_note: W1-b (2026-11-07), see mesen2-results/W1-b_20261107.md. Shipped notes that say 'no setter' (layerPriorityFlag bit 12), 'never written' ($06F0) or 'no reader' (forcedScrollOverride $06C8) are contradicted by the census: SceneCmd_ConfigDisplay (166728) sets $06EF bit 4 in scenes $59 $8C-$8F $C0 $FE (the copy it enables ran in $8C-$8F and, with the world-map name text, in $FE); SceneCmd_ConfigDisplay (166571) stores $06F1 and InitActorFromSceneData (249668) ORs the $06F0 word into oamXorFlags in 989 spawns; WriteBgScroll (33753) read $06C8 3320 times in scenes $4E $58 $A0 $A1 and BG2HOFS / BG1HOFS equalled $06C8 & $03FF on all 1952 override passes checked. The flag $FF comment keeps its text and drops '(inferred)': all 14 685 run-time tests of flag $FF (byte $0A1F, mask $80) in the 11 follow-up sessions came from thinker slots (D = $0F00-$0FFF). Dry-run only: npm run merge -- plans/extracted-audit/mesen2-results/specs/W1-b_notes.json --dry-run.

edit.find: No setter for bit 12 of layerPriorityFlag was found in the extracted code, so what triggers this mode is unconfirmed.
edit.with: SceneCmd_ConfigDisplay sets the bit: the low 5 bits of display_preset_table record byte +7 go to scrollModeFlags ($06EF), and bit 4 of that byte is bit 12 of this word. The presets with it belong to scenes $59, $8C-$8F, $C0 and $FE; the preset write of every other scene clears it. The copy needs a nonzero $00DA: the prologue scenes $8C-$8F fill it and so does the destination-name display of the world map in $FE (measured: the copy runs there with $00DA = $24 and $38), while $59 and $C0 take this branch with $00DA = 0 in the measured frames and return at once.
